chapter: St. Cyr, Dreamland and the OK festival
title: Identifying the clarinetist again: Stump Evans, Clifford King, Billy Page
summary: Allen returns to the unknown clarinetist; Stump Evans sounds most familiar to her and he will compare records.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Who were the great clarinetists? Favorites and rivals

blocks.x: And... I wonder if that leads us into anybody on that clarinet. Do you remember ever making a record with Clifford King? Clarinet King.

All right. No, I don't. Stump Evans was with King Oliver about the time that we're talking about. He was also occasionally at one of the show houses. Then there was another clarinetist by the name of Billy Page, who was around that time. Now, you think that the name Stump Evans sounds as familiar as anything that brought up nicely?
Yes. Uh-huh. It does. I should say so. Yes, it does.
Well, I am not sufficiently familiar with Evans, and I'll go back and compare your records. But it's very familiar.
Mm-hmm. I'll stop Evans right there. We can find that out.
